name: io.github.opsknight-labs/opsknight
title: OpsKnight
description: Self-hosted incident management: incidents, on-call, services, runbooks, reviewed changes.

host.description: Host name of your own OpsKnight installation (its App URL without https://), for example opsknight.example.com. Sign in with OAuth when your assistant asks.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth. For agents without OAuth: Bearer followed by a personal access token created under Settings > Integrations > MCP > Connections (when your administrator allows them).
